Description
The University of Sussex is a public research university located in Brighton. Sussex has a diverse community of nearly 20,000 students, coming from overseas. The University counts 5 Nobel Prize winners, 15 Fellows of the Royal Society, 10 Fellows of the British Academy, 24 fellows of the Academy of Social Sciences and a winner of the Crafoord Prize among its faculty. Alumni include heads of states, diplomats, politicians, eminent scientists and activists.
